scope: Pausader, Perez-Garcia and the joint Rhodes-Vargas report, locally integrated and validated.

remaining_branches.branch: Large data, optimal topology and low dimensions
remaining_branches.scope: 4H1H/4H1I represent report§6 questions1–3 as open or conditional. No large-initial-data scattering or two-dimensional asymptotic framework proved.

4H0J/0K prove reference-flow facts only. Full self-consistent repulsive-charge stability theorem, convex absorbing-domain nonlinear scattering and attractive point-mass trapped dynamics are not reconstructed; boundary problem beyond torus remains open context.

The exact Poisson model and Gevrey torus theorem are covered. General linear spectral decomposition for arbitrary tails is not fully stated or proved. Survey ref4 thick-tail extension through gamma=2 remains in preparation, not an available proof; thin-tail nonlinear damping is an open question in the survey.

Same-minimal-period linear result only. General tangent-completion geometry, all higher compatibility functionals, Fprime(0)=0, non-global-energy states, other periods, nonlinear modulation and unstable-orbit endpoints remain unexpanded.

Moment and Schrodinger–Poisson definitions, screening and relativistic low-frequency computation are included. Full Vlasov–Maxwell magnetic-wave theory, quantum analogues, rigorous quasilinear modulation and high-dimensional confined BGK classification are not developed. These match report§6 questions8–11 context.

unexpanded_deep_proofs.scope: Nonlinear characteristic bootstrap, weighted derivative propagation, convergence of the asymptotic field, singular-time wave-operator contraction and global extension cited. Source classes now specified; no uniqueness for arbitrary weak solutions.
Nonlinear resonant field decomposition, all §§3–7 estimates and §8 closure not reproduced.
Endpoint Gevrey nonlinear bootstrap, echo chains, causal response estimates, final-state construction and scattering injectivity proofs cited.

Bifurcation tangent theorem, operator-valued dielectric expansion, small eigenvalue analysis, modulation projections and time-integrated damping proof cited. Local pendulum geometry is not a proof of the stability sign criterion.
Elementary energy/Abel identities proved locally; full smooth BGK manifold parametrization and all endpoint compatibility/positivity conditions are not reproduced.

remaining_branches.scope: Conjectures 3.1 and 3.2 remain conjectural. No formal resolution of nonchirality, generic representative existence or completeness of anyon invariants is asserted.

Axioms and biconnectedness are defined; the §3.4 family is identified by its exact primary source, not reconstructed coefficient by coefficient. General MPO tensors, weights, integral elements, faithful representation choices and tensor-diagram manipulations remain a research branch.

remaining_branches.branch: Phase invariance and quantum-double sector identification
remaining_branches.scope: The report discussion of approximate duality invariance, full braided C* categories, equivalence with representations of D(G), and same-category string-net phase equivalence is contextual. Exact contracts and proofs of report references [9], [35], [44] are not independently developed here.

Rotationally symmetric and 1D spectral undecidability, quantum-hardness of phase recognition, symmetry-protected classifications, entanglement bootstrap and Hall conductance are contextual, not separate fully developed branches.
Busy Beaver height-10^7 decimal tower is attributed to the report as a historical lower bound in its exact binary model, not a current-record claim.

unexpanded_deep_proofs.scope: Undecidable Hamiltonian construction, quantum phase estimation/history Hamiltonians, tiling hierarchy, explicit d=10 size-driven model and perturbative stability are quoted research results. Only halting and reduction logic is proved locally.

General weighted weak-Hopf bulk-boundary, intersection, local indistinguishability, two-dimensional operator transfer and cone geometry proofs are cited. One-dimensional diagrams are illustrations, never the full general proof.

Rieffel–van Daele theorem, factor compression faithfulness/lifting, and finite-to-infinite error analysis are cited. All usable hypotheses are recorded, and elementary decomposition is separately proved.

Sector selection and elementary intertwiner tensor structure are explicit; transport-independent braiding, rigidity/semisimplicity of physical sectors, categorical dimension theory and general F-symbol pentagon/projector calculations are not reconstructed.

remaining_branches.scope: Report §9 context retained; full boundary structure constants, Fyodorov–Bouchaud and interval laws, and annulus random modulus not developed as additional theorem pages.
Introductory motivation and §9 directions acknowledged; no full planar-map scaling, mating-of-trees or percolation-exponent proofs claimed.

Local geometric factor and almost-everywhere block convergence retained. Full Teichmuller line bundle, Schwarzian cocycle, projective mapping-class representation and Verlinde equivalence not constructed. Correspondence remains conjectural in the report.

remaining_branches.scope: Report §9 is a dated source survey. Formal/analytic distinction expanded in 4J19; JT semiclassical claims and general bootstrap extensions are not promoted to proved universal statements or current-status surveys.
Extended analytic continuation and critical renormalizations not developed; fourpoint formula restricted to stated pair-charge inequalities.

unexpanded_deep_proofs.scope: Compact elliptic spectral basis, Weyl law, and spectral-zeta meromorphic continuation are precisely quoted standard theorems. Green local remainder and Gaussian Sobolev convergence are separately proved.

Full subcritical GMC existence/nondegeneracy, singular negative moments, simultaneous vertex limits and general Weyl anomaly are cited. Circle averages, finite/Gaussian-field shifts and zero-mode calculation are local.

DOZZ integrability, probabilistic BPZ decoupling, reflection identification, parameter analytic continuation and global Upsilon theorem not reproved. Algebraic null-vector calculation and conditional BPZ implication are local.

Continuous domain Markov construction, determinant gluing, full Segal amplitudes, projective annulus representation and operator differentiability are cited. Conditional expectation, kernel contraction and radial calculation are local.

Singular interaction form at larger coupling, self-adjoint realization, scattering completeness, weighted analytic continuation and exact reflection coefficient are cited; bounded self-adjoint spectral theorem is not substituted.

Analytic Ward identities, holomorphic factorization, block convergence almost everywhere and justified spectral integrals are cited. Ward coefficient arithmetic, inverse Gram algebra, topology counts and conditional crossing consequence are local.
